If we confess our sins, he who is faithful and just will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
points.apply: If a past sin still weighs on you, confess it and then trust that God remembers it no more.

sub: A field, oxen, a marriage: good things as excuses.
The poor and the lame are brought in.
There is still room.
q: Ho, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; and you that have no money, come, buy and eat!
Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.
points.apply: Bring one person with you to the Holy Qurbono this Sunday.

concl: Christ's one sacrifice is complete, and it is made present for us at every Holy Qurbono.
God's table is ready; let no good thing become our excuse, and let us fill his house.
2027-04-17.resolve: Tonight, set aside one excuse and prepare your heart and your family for the Lord's Day.

intro: Theme: “He who has promised is faithful.”
On the Monday after Emmaus Sunday: the new and living way, the assembly we must not neglect, and the shepherd who searches.

sub: The curtain of the temple torn.
Through his flesh, given and raised.
Approach with a true heart.
q: Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord? And who shall stand in his holy place? Those who have clean hands and pure hearts
At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom.
points.apply: When the sanctuary curtain is drawn back at the Holy Qurbono, thank Christ for opening heaven to you.

points.h: Do not neglect to meet together
sub: Hold fast to the confession of hope.
Provoke one another to love.
Encourage one another as the Day approaches.
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers.
points.apply: Never miss the Sunday Qurbono this Easter season, and encourage one other person to come.

sub: The grumbling of the righteous.
Until he finds it.
Joy in heaven over one sinner.
q: I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the strayed, and I will bind up the injured, and I will strengthen the weak
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
points.apply: Visit or call one person who has wandered from the parish, and tell them they are missed.

concl: Through the flesh of the risen Christ the way into God's presence is open.
The Shepherd seeks the lost; we are sent to seek them with him and to welcome them home with joy.
2027-04-19.resolve: This week, bring one wanderer one step nearer to the Sunday assembly.

intro: Theme: “You cannot serve God and wealth.”
On this Easter Tuesday: one Master, the covenant of marriage, and the merciful hands of the living God.

sub: Faithful with little, entrusted with much.
Money: a servant, not a master.
God knows the heart.
q: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.
For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil
points.apply: Set aside a fixed share of your income for the poor this month, before other spending.

sub: Back to the beginning.
A word of protection.
Accompanying those whose marriages have broken.
q: Therefore a man leaves his father and his mother and clings to his wife, and they become one flesh.
Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.
points.apply: Pray today for a married couple you know who are struggling, and offer them practical help if you can.

points.h: The hands of the living God
sub: The one sacrifice must not be spurned.
The Church keeps the door of Penance open.
“Let us fall into the hand of the Lord.”
q: As I live, says the Lord God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from their ways and live
But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous
points.apply: Go to confession this week if you have been staying away.

concl: Christ alone is our Master; money must serve him and the poor.
God's warnings are the voice of his mercy, calling us back to the one sacrifice and the open door of forgiveness.
2027-04-20.resolve: This week, put God first in your spending, and choose his merciful hand in confession.

intro: Theme: “Do not, therefore, abandon that confidence of yours; it brings a great reward.”
On this Easter Wednesday: the confidence of the enlightened, the forgiveness that faith makes possible, and the mustard seed.

sub: Baptism as enlightenment.
Suffering endured with joy.
The righteous live by faith.
q: Look at the proud! Their spirit is not right in them, but the righteous live by their faith.
Blessed is anyone who endures temptation. Such a one has stood the test and will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.
points.apply: Find the date of your Baptism and thank God for it at the Holy Qurbono this week.

sub: Woe to those who cause the little ones to stumble.
Rebuke in love.
Forgive again and again.
q: Forgive your neighbor the wrong he has done, and then your sins will be pardoned when you pray.
Jesus said to him, “Not seven times, but, I tell you, seventy-seven times.”
points.apply: Forgive one person today whom you had stopped forgiving, and tell God so in prayer.

sub: The honest prayer of the apostles.
The mustard seed.
The mulberry tree of old resentment.
q: If you do not stand firm in faith, you shall not stand at all.
Immediately the father of the child cried out, “I believe; help my unbelief!”
points.apply: Before the Holy Qurbono each day this week, pray: “Lord, increase our faith.”

concl: The light of Baptism gives us a confidence that brings a great reward; we must not abandon it.
Faith as small as a mustard seed, rooted in the risen Lord, makes forgiveness possible.
2027-04-21.resolve: This week, remember your Baptism, protect the little ones, and forgive once more.

intro: Theme: “Let us run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus.”
On Thursday of the third week after Qyomtho: the cloud of witnesses, the eyes fixed on Jesus, and the prayer that does not lose heart.

sub: The stadium of faith.
Laying aside every weight.
We never run alone.
q: but those who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength, they shall mount up with wings like eagles, they shall run and not be weary, they shall walk and not faint.
Do you not know that in a race the runners all compete, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may win it.
points.apply: Choose one saint to be your companion this week and ask for his or her prayers each morning.

sub: The pioneer who has run the course.
The joy beyond the Cross.
The perfecter of our faith.
q: Look to him, and be radiant; so your faces shall never be ashamed.
forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the heavenly call of God in Christ Jesus.
points.apply: Spend five quiet minutes before a crucifix or an icon of the Resurrection and simply look.

points.h: Pray always and do not lose heart
sub: A widow with nothing but persistence.
Not an unjust judge, but a Father.
Will he find faith on earth?
q: Evening and morning and at noon I utter my complaint and moan, and he will hear my voice.
Rejoice always, pray without ceasing, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you.
points.apply: Keep the evening prayer as a family every day until Sunday, and add the one intention you had dropped.

concl: The saints have finished the race and cheer us on; Jesus has run it first and waits at its end.
Persevering prayer is the breath of the runner: the Father never tires of hearing it.
2027-04-22.resolve: Fix your eyes on Jesus, take up again the prayer you dropped, and do not lose heart.

intro: Theme: “Share in suffering like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.”
On the feast of Mar Geevarghese Sahada: the good soldier, the sheep among wolves, and the witness of the Resurrection.

points.h: A good soldier of Christ Jesus
sub: Strong in grace.
Not entangled in everyday affairs.
Pleasing the one who enlisted us.
q: I hereby command you: Be strong and courageous; do not be frightened or dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his power. Put on the whole armor of God, so that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
points.apply: Each morning this week, before work or school, make the sign of the Cross slowly and offer the day to Christ as his soldier.

points.h: Sheep in the midst of wolves
sub: Wise as serpents, innocent as doves.
Dragged before governors and kings.
The Spirit speaks through them.
q: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I fear no evil; for you are with me;
Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
points.apply: Pray by name for one country where Christians suffer for their faith, and learn one fact about their situation.

points.h: Sahada: a witness of the risen Lord
sub: No one dies for a lie.
The cause makes the martyr.
The dragon and our daily refusals.
q: If our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the furnace of blazing fire and out of your hand, O king, let him deliver us. But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods
But they have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, for they did not cling to life even in the face of death.
points.apply: Choose one wrong thing you will refuse this week for Christ's sake, quietly and firmly.

concl: Mar Geevarghese was faithful in a soldier's daily duty, and so he was faithful in the hour of trial.
The martyrs are witnesses of Qyomtho: they died because they knew the Lord was alive.
2027-04-23.resolve: Be strong in grace, pray for persecuted Christians, and make one faithful refusal for Christ this week.

intro: Theme: “God, be merciful to me, a sinner!”
On Saturday of the third week after Qyomtho: two men at prayer, the discipline of a Father, and the pursuit of peace and holiness.

points.h: Two men went up to pray
sub: The Pharisee's list.
The tax collector's need.
Justified, not by comparison, but by mercy.
q: The sacrifice acceptable to God is a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will exalt you.
points.apply: Before Sunday, make a good confession, or at least an honest examination of conscience that begins with yourself.

sub: Not yet to the point of blood.
Correction as a sign of love.
The peaceful fruit of righteousness.
q: My child, do not despise the Lord's discipline or be weary of his reproof, for the Lord reproves the one he loves, as a father the son in whom he delights.
I reprove and discipline those whom I love. Be earnest, therefore, and repent.
points.apply: Recall one correction that once hurt and later helped you, and thank God for it.

sub: The holiness without which no one sees the Lord.
Roots of bitterness.
Esau's single meal.
q: You shall be holy, for I the Lord your God am holy.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
points.apply: Take one concrete step of reconciliation before tomorrow's Qurbono.

concl: The proud man shows God his healthy limbs; the humble man shows his wounds and is healed.
God's discipline is the love of a Father who wants us to share his holiness.
2027-04-24.resolve: Pray the tax collector's prayer with your heart, accept God's correction, and pursue peace before you come to the altar.

intro: Theme: “You have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God.”
On Monday of the fourth week after Qyomtho: the generous sower, the heavenly liturgy, and the soil of our hearts.

sub: Fire, darkness and a trembling people.
The festal gathering of angels and saints.
The blood that speaks a better word.
q: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking, they were afraid and trembled and stood at a distance
For you did not receive a spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received a spirit of adoption.
points.apply: At your next Qurbono, when “Holy, holy, holy” is sung, remember that you are singing with the angels.

sub: The heavenly Jerusalem.
The assembly of the firstborn.
The Holy Qurbono as heaven on earth.
q: On this mountain the Lord of hosts will make for all peoples a feast of rich food, a feast of well-aged wines, of rich food filled with marrow, of well-aged wines strained clear.
After this I looked, and there was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb
points.apply: Come to the Qurbono five minutes early this week and spend them in silence.

sub: The trampled path.
The rocky ground with no root.
Thorns of worry and the hundredfold harvest.
q: so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
welcome with meekness the implanted word that has the power to save your souls.
points.apply: Write one sentence from today's Gospel on a card and read it each morning this week.

concl: God sows his word generously; the harvest depends on the soil we give it.
At the Holy Qurbono we come to Mount Zion, where the word is spoken and the Blood of Jesus speaks mercy.
2027-04-26.resolve: Prepare the soil of your heart before every Qurbono, and keep one word from the readings all week.

intro: Theme: “Since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us give thanks.”
On Tuesday of the fourth week after Qyomtho, with St Cletus: what shakes, what remains, and the treasure we must not cling to.

points.h: Do not refuse the one who is speaking
sub: God's voice shook Sinai.
Now he speaks from heaven.
Today, listen.
q: O that today you would listen to his voice! Do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah
My sheep hear my voice. I know them, and they follow me.
points.apply: Give ten minutes each day this week to reading the Gospel slowly, asking: Lord, what are you saying to me?

points.h: A kingdom that cannot be shaken
sub: Everything made will be tested.
Thanksgiving with reverence and awe.
St Cletus and the Church built on the rock.
q: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we will not fear, though the earth should change, though the mountains shake in the heart of the sea
And I tell you, you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
points.apply: Pray today for the Pope and for the bishops of our Church.

sub: The rich ruler's sadness.
What is impossible for mortals.
Much more in this age, and eternal life.
q: Now the Lord said to Abram, “Go from your country and your kindred and your father’s house to the land that I will show you.”
More than that, I regard everything as loss because of the surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord.
points.apply: Give away one thing you are attached to, this week, to someone who needs it.

concl: Everything that can be shaken will pass; the kingdom of the risen Christ remains.
What we leave for Christ is not lost; it is kept in his kingdom and given back many times over.
2027-04-27.resolve: Listen to the one who speaks from heaven, loosen your grip on what passes, and give thanks at the altar for the kingdom that cannot be shaken.

intro: Theme: “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.”
On the memory of Most Rev. Isaac Mar Yoohanon: remembering our shepherds, the altar we have, and the faithful steward.

sub: A family with a memory.
Considering the outcome of their life.
Praying for our departed shepherds.
q: I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
And when the chief shepherd appears, you will win the crown of glory that never fades away.
points.apply: Pray today by name for the departed bishops and priests who served your parish or family.

sub: The one sacrifice made present.
Outside the camp, looking for the city to come.
The sacrifices of praise and of sharing.
q: For from the rising of the sun to its setting my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense is offered to my name, and a pure offering
The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a sharing in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a sharing in the body of Christ?
points.apply: Make one act of sharing this week, in money, time or food, as an offering flowing from the altar.

sub: Food at the proper time.
“My master is delayed.”
Found at work when he comes.
q: Not so with my servant Moses; he is entrusted with all my house.
Think of us in this way, as servants of Christ and stewards of God’s mysteries. Moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found trustworthy.
points.apply: Name one person who depends on you and give them what they truly need this week.

concl: Shepherds pass; the Christ they served is the same yesterday and today and forever.
Every Christian is a steward, and the Lord will come to find us at work.
2027-04-28.resolve: Remember and pray for those who gave you the faith, live from the altar, and be a faithful steward of what God has entrusted to you.

intro: Theme: “The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do this.”
On Thursday of the fourth week after Qyomtho, with St Catherine of Siena: oil in the lamps, the whole person made holy, and a saint on fire for the Church.

sub: Wise and foolish bridesmaids.
The bridegroom delayed.
The oil that cannot be borrowed.
q: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
points.apply: Spend fifteen minutes today in quiet prayer, and let it become a daily habit until Pentecost.

sub: Spirit, soul and body.
The faithful God who will do it.
Holiness in a praying community.
q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
I appeal to you therefore, brothers and sisters, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship.
points.apply: Offer one bodily discipline to God this week: an early rising for prayer, a fast from screens, a visit to the sick.

sub: The risen Christ, Bridegroom of the Church.
St Catherine's lamp and fire.
Ready for the wedding banquet.
q: and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your God rejoice over you.
Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.
points.apply: Pray each day this week for the Pope and our bishops, as St Catherine did.

concl: The oil of love is filled in prayer and cannot be borrowed at the last hour.
St Catherine's burning lamp became fire for the whole Church; the faithful God can do the same in us.
2027-04-29.resolve: Fill your lamp in prayer, offer God your whole self, and stay ready for the Bridegroom.

intro: Theme: “For the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.”
On the feast of Mar Yaqob Shleeha: the cup instead of the throne, greatness as service, and the burdens we carry for one another.

points.h: Are you able to drink the cup?
sub: Two brothers ask for thrones.
“We are able.”
The first apostle to give his life.
q: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord
About that time King Herod laid violent hands upon some who belonged to the church. He had James, the brother of John, killed with the sword.
points.apply: Accept one hardship today without complaint, as a small share in the Lord's cup.

points.h: The Son of Man came to serve
sub: Rulers who lord it over others.
“It is not so among you.”
A ransom for many.
q: The righteous one, my servant, shall make many righteous, and he shall bear their iniquities.
So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
points.apply: Do one hidden act of service today for someone who cannot repay you.

sub: Restoring the fallen with gentleness.
Each carries his load, and helps with another's.
Do not grow weary in doing what is right.
q: But Moses’ hands grew weary; so they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side, and the other on the other side
Little children, let us love, not in word or speech, but in truth and action.
points.apply: Take on one burden of someone at home or at work this week without being asked.

concl: James asked for a throne and was given a cup; drinking it, he found the true glory.
In the kingdom of the risen Lord, greatness is service and the first place belongs to the servant of all.
2027-04-30.resolve: Choose the cup over the throne: serve quietly, restore gently, carry another's burden, and do not grow weary in doing good.
